description: Hand-seeded verb-lemma → edge_type mapping. The verb-side counterpart to the noun-side lemma_concept_def edges. When the statement extractor sees a verb in a paragraph, this map tells it which canonical edge_type to use. Entries grow empirically over time via collapse_decisions: a verb that consistently resolves to the same edge type sharpens its confidence; new verbs accumulate observations and graduate to first-class dictionary entries.
rationale: Surface verbs are polysemous (own/owned/owns/possessed/held/had/acquired all map to `owns`). Without this dictionary the LLM extractor has to invent the predicate per-occurrence — that's where the 19,838 invalid edges came from. The dictionary is the gate.
